title: Permissions-Policy grants a powerful feature to every origin
description: The Permissions-Policy header contains a wildcard grant for a powerful feature such as camera, microphone or geolocation. Any embedded frame can then request the feature without the top-level document narrowing it, which is the opposite of what the header exists to do. The check reports the wildcard grant on one observation; it does not claim the feature is actually reachable.
remediation: Replace wildcard grants with an explicit allowlist of origins, or close the feature with an empty allowlist (camera=()).
limitation: Observation-level: the check reads the declared header text and does not evaluate how a browser applies the policy to a specific frame.
